notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE
notes.notes:
!!!IMPORTANT!!!
If your Kado album is empty after an update, just visit KADO-TRADER Miko and click on “Update Kado Album”! This will bring your Kado album back to its normal state! Please excuse these circumstances!

 https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45038323/30bb0ad7847b4a39d68a8db6dfe5e7f5878bd1bb.png

Happy Halloween, KADO HUNTER! The ZPOOKIEST time of the year stands before! 
…
You don’t know what Halloween is? Then it’s time! Zpooky from the Halloween-Committee will send Jacko to Vanada to get y’all in touch with Halloween!  
You’ll find Jacko in the upper floor in the Kado Shop – just follow the stairs beside the pumpkin. Jacko has – as far as I know – brought some sweets. ;)
 
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45038323/3e00129e3b535043d9a30ac31de803496444fcf7.png

In case you forget:
You get Spooky-Coins by defeating ghostly or demonic enemies as well as in the clay jars within the dungeons:

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45038323/3c14bca7725f3a386a6b14721fb8109de3bbf490.png https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45038323/ba4220a6e8102ef82bd609ea5e60694b3b644c86.png https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45038323/3ad3fcdb7ac9bf2f80864d8f3787d60968133c20.png
    

We hope you’ll enjoy it!
Your SaltyDevs!
